svg.text: FIGURE 4.4: DATA FLOW DIAGRAM (DFD LEVEL 1) — FUNCTIONAL DECOMPOSITION
Six Core Processing Subsystems, Six MongoDB Data Stores (D1–D6), Inter-Process Data Pipelines, and Actor Interfaces

g.text: • Request Problem List by Topic Tag
• Edit Code in Monaco Editor Workspace
• Run Sample Tests in AST Sandbox
• Salt & Hash Passwords via Bcrypt (10 rounds)
• Sign HS256 JWT tokens containing user ID & role
• Check TokenBlacklist store on every protected request
• Write revoked tokens to TTL index store upon logout
• Query problem documents with difficulty & tag filters
• Fetch problem details by unique SEO-friendly slug
• Hydrate Monaco editor with language starter code
• Strip hidden test cases from public API responses
• Scan source code for unsafe AST tokens & prototypes
• Execute code in-memory (Node VM) with 2500ms timeout
• Fall back to remote Judge0 API if local execution fails
• Measure runtime (ms) & memory; save submission record
• Generate 6-char room codes & initialize duel lobby
• Broadcast opponent testcase pass counts in real time
• Atomically adjust ELO ratings (+100 win / -25 loss)
• Aggregate 365-day submission history by calendar date
• Compute current & longest consecutive solve streaks
• Calculate difficulty solve ratios (Easy, Medium, Hard)
• Rank students globally and generate competitive badges
• Monitor active Socket.IO connections & server CPU load
• Execute Problem CRUD: create, update, deactivate
• Toggle student account suspension with instant token kill
• Assign and rotate 24-hour Daily Challenge problems
Interacts with: D1 (users), D2 (problems), D5 (daily), D6 (blacklist)
PERSISTENT DATA STORES (MONGODB ATLAS CLUSTER COLLECTIONS)
DFD LEVEL 1 NOTATION & DATA PIPELINE CONVENTIONS:
Numbered Process Circles (1.0–6.0): Functional Transformational Subsystems
Open-Ended Stores (D1–D6): MongoDB Database Collections with Specific Schemas
Data Flow Pipelines: Directed Information Flow with Explicit CRUD Semantics
Entities: External Actors Generating Input and Receiving System Output
Architectural Invariant: Zero direct inter-process database writes; all state mutations are gated through Mongoose schema validators and transaction guards.
